title: Dasakam 45 – Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s Childhood Play
description: Krishna and Balarama’s early play in Vraja unfolds from crawling and maternal care into village mischief, cosmic wonder, and the father’s vision of the universal form.
translation_note: No vetted English stanza translation supplied. Numbered intake captions are preserved verbatim as reference commentary, not treated as translations.

stanzas.sanskrit: अयि सबल मुरारे पाणिजानुप्रचारैः किमपि भवनभागान् भूषयन्तौ भवन्तौ । चलितचरणकञ्जौ मञ्जुमञ्जीरशिञ्जा-श्रवणकुतुकभाजौ चेरतुश्चारुवेगात् ॥ ४५-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi sabala murāre pāṇijānupracāraiḥ
kimapi bhavanabhāgān bhūṣayantau bhavantau |
calitacaraṇakañjau mañjumañjīraśiñjā-
-śravaṇakutukabhājau ceratuścāruvegāt || 45-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Balarama and Krishna started to crawl on their hands and knees. They were interested in hearing to the rhythmic sound made by their anklets put in their beautiful lotus flower like legs and hence crawled with great briskness.

stanzas.sanskrit: मृदु मृदु विहसन्तावुन्मिषद्दन्तवन्तौ वदनपतितकेशौ दृश्यपादाब्जदेशौ । भुजगलितकरान्तव्यालगत्कङ्कणाङ्कौ मतिमहरतमुच्चैः पश्यतां विश्वनॄणाम् ॥ ४५-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
mṛdu mṛdu vihasantāvunmiṣaddantavantau
vadanapatitakeśau dṛśyapādābjadeśau |
bhujagalitakarāntavyālagatkaṅkaṇāṅkau
matimaharatamuccaiḥ paśyatāṃ viśvanṝṇām || 45-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Both of them smiled exposing their beautiful new teeth, hair locks falling on their faces and the lotus like feet, armlets slipping down to the wrists, becoming like bracelets were very attractive and captivated the minds of all the people.

stanzas.sanskrit: अनुसरति जनौघे कौतुकव्याकुलाक्षे किमपि कृतनिनादं व्याहसन्तौ द्रवन्तौ । वलितवदनपद्मं पृष्ठतो दत्तदृष्टी किमिव न विदधाथे कौतुकं वासुदेव ॥ ४५-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
anusarati janaughe kautukavyākulākṣe
kimapi kṛtaninādaṃ vyāhasantau dravantau |
valitavadanapadmaṃ pṛṣṭhato dattadṛṣṭī
kimiva na vidadhāthe kautukaṃ vāsudeva || 45-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The people who watched both of them  crawl, followed them everywhere. Both ran away after giving an enchanting smile. When people stopped following both, the duo turned their lotus faces back, casting a look, giving incredible joy to the people.

stanzas.sanskrit: द्रुतगतिषु पतन्तावुत्थितौ लिप्तपङ्कौ दिवि मुनिभिरपङ्कैः सस्मितं वन्द्यमानौ । द्रुतमथ जननीभ्यां सानुकम्पं गृहीतौ मुहुरपि परिरब्धौ द्राग्युवां चुम्बितौ च ॥ ४५-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
drutagatiṣu patantāvutthitau liptapaṅkau
divi munibhirapaṅkaiḥ sasmitaṃ vandyamānau |
drutamatha jananībhyāṃ sānukampyaṃ gṛhītau
muhurapi parirabdhau drāgyuvāṃ cumbitau ca || 45-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: While moving fast, Krishna would fall down and get smeared and tainted by mud, Sages in the heaven witnessed these pranks of Bhagwan and worshipped them. Rohini and Yashoda came quickly and lifted them up carefully and embraced them, kissed them again and again with great joy.

stanzas.sanskrit: स्नुतकुचभरमङ्के धारयन्ती भवन्तं तरलमति यशोदा स्तन्यदा धन्यधन्या । कपटपशुप मध्ये मुग्धहासाङ्कुरं ते दशनमुकुलहृद्यं वीक्ष्य वक्त्रं जहर्ष ॥ ४५-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
snutakucabharamaṅke dhārayantī bhavantaṃ
taralamati yaśodā stanyadā dhanyadhanyā |
kapaṭapaśupa madhye mugdhahāsāṅkuraṃ te
daśanamukulahṛdyaṃ vīkṣya vaktraṃ jaharṣa || 45-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The soft hearted Yashoda took the baby Krishna on her lap and fed him. While taking the feed, Krishna would stop in between and smile at Yashoda charmingly,  adding immense joy to her.

stanzas.sanskrit: तदनु चरणचारी दारकैः साकमारा-न्निलयततिषु खेलन् बालचापल्यशाली । भवनशुकबिडालान् वत्सकांश्चानुधावन् कथमपि कृतहासैर्गोपकैर्वारितोऽभूः ॥ ४५-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadanu caraṇacārī dārakaiḥ sākamārā-
-nnilayatatiṣu khelan bālacāpalyaśālī |
bhavanaśukabiḍālān vatsakāṃścānudhāvan
kathamapi kṛtahāsairgopakairvārito’bhūḥ || 45-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Soon Krishna started to walk and started to run and play with the Gopa boys in the neighbourhood. Krishna ran behind pets, cows and calves in the houses and Gopa boys with great difficulty restrained Krishna from doing these pranks.

stanzas.sanskrit: हलधरसहितस्त्वं यत्र यत्रोपयातो विवशपतितनेत्रास्तत्र तत्रैव गोप्यः । विगलितगृहकृत्या विस्मृतापत्यभृत्या मुरहर मुहुरत्यन्ताकुला नित्यमासन् ॥ ४५-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
haladharasahitastvaṃ yatra yatropayāto
vivaśapatitanetrāstatra tatraiva gopyaḥ |
vigalitagṛhakṛtyā vismṛtāpatyabhṛtyā
murahara muhuratyantākulā nityamāsan || 45-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna and Balarama went everywhere together. Gopikas were watching and  following them, leaving their household chores, children, family behind. This became the routine for the gopikas.

stanzas.sanskrit: प्रतिनवनवनीतं गोपिकादत्तमिच्छन् कलपदमुपगायन् कोमलं क्वापि नृत्यन् । सदययुवतिलोकैरर्पितं सर्पिरश्नन् क्वचन नवविपक्वं दुग्धमप्यापिबस्त्वम् ॥ ४५-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pratinavanavanītaṃ gopikādattamicchan
kalapadamupagāyan komalaṃ kvāpi nṛtyan |
sadayayuvatilokairarpitaṃ sarpiraśnan
kvacana navavipakvaṃ dugdhamapyāpibastvam || 45-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna loved the freshly made butter given by gopikas. Sometimes Krishna sang sweetly or danced graciously, captivating the Gopikas. With lot of affection, Gopikas served him with freshly boiled milk which he drank with delight.

stanzas.sanskrit: मम खलु बलिगेहे याचनं जातमास्ता-मिह पुनरबलानामग्रतो नैव कुर्वे । इति विहितमतिः किं देव सन्त्यज्य याच्ञां दधिघृतमहरस्त्वं चारुणा चोरणेन ॥ ४५-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
mama khalu baligehe yācanaṃ jātamāstā-
-miha punarabalānāmagrato naiva kurve |
iti vihitamatiḥ kiṃ deva santyajya yācñāṃ
dadhighṛtamaharastvaṃ cāruṇā coraṇena || 45-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan having begged Mahabali for food in his Vamana avatharam, now in this Krishna avatharam decided to not beg gopikas for butter but decided to silently steal from their pots.

stanzas.sanskrit: तव दधिघृतमोषे घोषयोषाजनाना-मभजत हृदि रोषो नावकाशं न शोकः । हृदयमपि मुषित्वा हर्षसिन्धौ न्यधास्त्वं स मम शमय रोगान् वातगेहाधिनाथ ॥ ४५-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tava dadhighṛtamoṣe ghoṣayoṣājanānā-
-mabhajata hṛdi roṣo nāvakāśaṃ na śokaḥ |
hṛdayamapi muṣitvā harṣasindhau nyadhāstvaṃ
sa mama śamaya rogān vātagehādhinātha || 45-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Baby Krishna’s clever tricks delighted the gopikas more than making them angry. Krishna along with stealing butter and ghee from gopikas, stole their hearts as well and immersed them in the ocean of Bliss.

stanzas.sanskrit: शाखाग्रे विधुं विलोक्य फलमित्यम्बां च तातं मुहुः सम्प्रार्थ्याथ तदा तदीयवचसा प्रोत्क्षिप्तबाहौ त्वयि । चित्रं देव शशी स ते कर्मगात् किं ब्रूमहे सम्पतः ज्योतिर्मण्डलपूरिताखिलवपुः प्रागा विराड्रूपताम् ॥ ११ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śākhāgre vidhuṃ vilokya phalamityambāṃ ca tātaṃ muhuḥ
samprārthyātha tadā tadīyavacasā protkṣiptabāhau tvayi |
citraṃ deva śaśī sa te karmagāt kiṃ brūmahe sampataḥ
jyotirmaṇḍalapūritākhilavapuḥ prāgā virāḍrūpatām || 11 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: On the front end of the branch of a tree, watching the moon, Bhagwan asked the  mother and father again and again for it, saying that it was a fruit. At that time, then, Bhagwan’s arms flung  and amazingly, the  moon came into Bhagwan’s hands! Bhagwan’s whole body was covered by luminous light in cosmic form!

stanzas.sanskrit: किं किं बतेदमिति सम्भ्रम भाजमेनं ब्रह्मार्णवे क्षणममुं परिमज्ज्य तातम् । मायां पुनस्तनय-मोहमयीं वितन्वान् आनन्दचिन्मय जगन्मय पाहि रोगात् ॥ १२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kiṃ kiṃ batedamiti sambhrama bhājamenaṃ
brahmārṇave kṣaṇamamuṃ parimajjya tātam |
māyāṃ punastanaya-mohamayīṃ vitanvān
ānandacinmaya jaganmaya pāhi rogāt || 12 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Bhagwan immersed the father in the cosmic ocean for a moment, then again came up as the enchanting form of a son. 
Bhattathri prays, That, Bliss incarnate,Supreme Consciousness, Cosmic form, O Krishna! save me from disease!
